name: cloude-code-toolbox-vscode
displayName: Claude Code ToolBox (MCP, Skills, Cursor/Copilot → Claude)
description: Claude Code ToolBox: MCP hub, workspace helpers, Thinking Machine Mode (context packs & priming), readiness, and bridges from Cursor to Claude Code in VS Code. Not affiliated with Microsoft, GitHub, or Anthropic. See README disclaimer. Workflow ideas credited in NOTICE (everything-claude-code, MIT).
author: amitchorasiya

cloude-code-toolbox.npxTag.description: npm dist-tag or version appended after @ for npx packages (e.g. latest or 1.0.1).

cloude-code-toolbox.embeddedBridgeNodeEx.description: Absolute path to the Node.js binary for hub “Without npx” bundled CLIs. Leave empty to run the command `node` from the integrated terminal PATH (same expectation as npx). Do not point at VS Code itself — `node` must be a real Node install.

cloude-code-toolbox.useInsidersPaths.description: Resolve user mcp.json under VS Code Insiders instead of stable.

cloude-code-toolbox.intelligence.include.description: Pre-select “Include git” in the context pack quick pick (still confirm each run).
Pre-select “Include diagnostics” in the context pack quick pick.

cloude-code-toolbox.intelligence.appendN.description: Pre-select “Append to session notepad” after building a context pack.

cloude-code-toolbox.intelligence.openCha.description: Pre-select “Open Claude Code” after building a context pack.

cloude-code-toolbox.translateWrapMultili.description: When translating selection, wrap multiline result in a markdown code fence (language = active editor).

cloude-code-toolbox.oneClickSetup.migrat.description: One Click runs the **Cursor → Claude Code** path: `.cursor/skills` migration (if enabled below), Cursor rules → `CLAUDE.md`, `.cursorrules` append, Cursor MCP → VS Code `mcp.json`, and memory-bank `--cursor-rules` when that setting is on.

One Click runs the **GitHub Copilot → Claude Code** path: optional merges below (e.g. `.github/copilot-instructions.md` → `CLAUDE.md`, Copilot skill folders → `.agents/skills`). VS Code `mcp.json` is shared with Copilot in the editor; use **MCP** hub + Claude `/mcp` for the Claude session.

cloude-code-toolbox.oneClickSetup.settin.description: Where One Click writes settings it updates (e.g. enabling auto-scan). User = global; workspace = folder .vscode/settings.json.
enumDescriptions: Write to the open workspace folder’s .vscode/settings.json when possible.
Write to your User settings (applies to all folders).

cloude-code-toolbox.oneClickSetup.initMe.description: Memory bank init (cloude-code-memory-bank): one mode per run. **Default: apply** — merges into CLAUDE.md and only adds missing memory-bank files (never overwrites existing templates).
enumDescriptions: Run init: merge-only (add missing files; merge memory-bank block in CLAUDE.md).
Run with --dry-run only (preview).
Skip memory bank init.

cloude-code-toolbox.oneClickSetup.initMe.description: When memory bank init runs and the **Cursor** migration track is on, add --cursor-rules to the CLI. Ignored when only the GitHub Copilot track runs.

cloude-code-toolbox.oneClickSetup.syncCu.description: Cursor rules → Claude (cursor-rules-to-claude): one mode per run. **Default: apply**. Merge-only policy: existing files are not replaced wholesale; toolbox-managed sections are refreshed.
enumDescriptions: Default — write .github/ outputs (when not dry).
Run with --dry-run (preview only).
Skip rules sync.

cloude-code-toolbox.oneClickSetup.append.description: If .cursorrules exists, merge into CLAUDE.md (replaceable block). **Default: on** for One Click.

cloude-code-toolbox.oneClickSetup.migrat.description: Migrate .cursor/skills → .agents/skills: pick one target (single-select). Copy/move is set below. Existing destination files are kept; migration adds missing files only.
enumDescriptions: Do not migrate skills during One Click.
Migrate under the open workspace folder only.
Migrate under your user home only.
Run migration for both workspace and user roots.

cloude-code-toolbox.oneClickSetup.migrat.description: How to migrate when the target above is not “off”.
enumDescriptions: Copy; keep files under .cursor/skills.
Copy then remove from .cursor/skills.

cloude-code-toolbox.oneClickSetup.mergeC.description: When the GitHub Copilot track is on: merge `.github/copilot-instructions.md` into root `CLAUDE.md` inside a replaceable toolbox block (after Cursor rules steps, before memory bank init).

cloude-code-toolbox.oneClickSetup.migrat.description: When the GitHub Copilot track is on: migrate `.github/skills` and/or `~/.copilot/skills` → `.agents/skills`. Copy/move is set below. Existing destination files are kept; migration adds missing files only.
enumDescriptions: Do not migrate Copilot/GitHub skill folders during One Click.
Migrate workspace `.github/skills` only.
Migrate user `~/.copilot/skills` only.
Migrate both workspace and user Copilot skill roots.

cloude-code-toolbox.oneClickSetup.migrat.description: Copy vs move for Copilot/GitHub skills migration when the target above is not “off”.
enumDescriptions: Copy; keep originals.
Copy then remove from source.

cloude-code-toolbox.oneClickSetup.copilo.description: When the GitHub Copilot track is on: after One Click, show a short reminder that VS Code `mcp.json` and Claude Code `/mcp` are separate surfaces.

cloude-code-toolbox.oneClickSetup.portCu.description: Port Cursor MCP target. Default: Claude Code user config (~/.claude.json). Legacy VS Code targets still available.
enumDescriptions: Merge into Claude Code user config (~/.claude.json) — recommended.
Merge into Claude Code project config (.mcp.json in workspace).
Merge into VS Code user mcp.json (legacy).
Merge into VS Code workspace .vscode/mcp.json (legacy).
Print JSON only (dry run).
Skip MCP port.

cloude-code-toolbox.oneClickSetup.instru.description: After bridges, how to treat MCP & Skills background auto-scan and merging MCP/skills into CLAUDE.md. Pick one (single-select).
enumDescriptions: Turn on auto-scan (using settings scope above) so future opens/scans merge the MCP/skills block.
Do not enable auto-scan; still merge once during the awareness step in this run.
Do not enable auto-scan from One Click and do not force a one-time merge (merge only if auto-scan was already on).

cloude-code-toolbox.oneClickSetup.runAwa.description: After bridges, run MCP & Skills scan (writes `.claude/cloude-code-toolbox-mcp-skills-awareness.md` and updates `CLAUDE.md`). Turning on auto-scan from One Click is separate (instructionMergeAfterOneClick).

cloude-code-toolbox.oneClickSetup.runCon.description: Run Claude Code / MCP config scan to Output.

cloude-code-toolbox.thinkingMachineMode..title: Thinking Machine Mode
cloude-code-toolbox.thinkingMachineMode..description: Master switch for Thinking Machine priming (hub + Command Palette). When you turn this on, confirm **Engage** in the dialog (Cancel turns it off). The hub has the same toggle under One Click Setup.
During Thinking Machine priming: run MCP & Skills awareness (writes `.claude/cloude-code-toolbox-mcp-skills-awareness.md`).
During Thinking Machine priming: merge the MCP/skills block into `CLAUDE.md` when running the awareness scan (same rules as interactive scan + auto-scan).
Show a confirmation before Thinking Machine priming writes under `.claude/` or `CLAUDE.md`, or copies the context pack.
When off, Thinking Machine priming uses the Claude Code ToolBox context pack defaults. When on, use the four overrides in this section instead.
Thinking Machine priming only: include git section in the context pack (when useSeparateContextPackDefaults is on).
Thinking Machine priming only: include diagnostics in the context pack (when useSeparateContextPackDefaults is on).
Thinking Machine priming only: append context pack to session notepad (when useSeparateContextPackDefaults is on).
Thinking Machine priming only: open Claude Code after copying the pack (when useSeparateContextPackDefaults is on).

cloude-code-toolbox.tokenOptimization.en.title: Token Optimization
cloude-code-toolbox.tokenOptimization.en.description: Master switch for Token Optimization. When enabled, merges concise-mode instructions into CLAUDE.md, generates a project map, and installs hooks for read deduplication and output compression.

enumDescriptions: No output restrictions.
1-3 sentences, no meta-commentary, no echoing (default).
Bullets only, maximum brevity, diff-style code changes.
JSON-only responses, zero English prose.
cloude-code-toolbox.tokenOptimization.ve.description: Controls how terse Claude's responses should be when Token Optimization is active.

cloude-code-toolbox.tokenOptimization.pr.description: Generate .claude/project-map.md (dependency graph) on activation and workspace open.
Maximum files to include in the project map scan.
File extensions to include in the project map.

cloude-code-toolbox.tokenOptimization.re.description: Install PreToolUse hook that warns on redundant file re-reads within a session.
Time window (ms) within which a re-read of an unchanged file is considered redundant.

cloude-code-toolbox.tokenOptimization.ou.description: Install PostToolUse hook that compresses verbose CLI output (git, npm, test runners).
Maximum lines of CLI output before compression kicks in.

cloude-code-toolbox.tokenOptimization.cl.description: Respect .claudeignore file — warns (never blocks) Claude when reading lockfiles, build output, node_modules, etc.

cloude-code-toolbox.tokenOptimization.co.description: Show tiered alerts when context window fill exceeds thresholds.
Context fill percentages (0-100) that trigger alerts.

cloude-code-toolbox.tokenOptimization.cl.description: Enable the CLAUDE.md token usage analyzer command.

cloude-code-toolbox.tokenOptimization.me.description: Merge verbosity/optimization instructions block into CLAUDE.md on activation.

cloude-code-toolbox.safetyGuards.enabled.title: AntiVibe Safety Guards
cloude-code-toolbox.safetyGuards.enabled.description: Master switch for AntiVibe Safety Guards. When enabled, installs hooks to block/warn on destructive commands, enforce domain whitelisting, and prevent supply chain attacks.

cloude-code-toolbox.safetyGuards.destruc.description: Enable the destructive command guard (rm -rf, git push --force, DROP TABLE, etc.).

enumDescriptions: Block the command (exit code 2 — Claude cannot proceed).
Warn via stderr but allow the command to run.
cloude-code-toolbox.safetyGuards.destruc.description: Whether to block destructive commands or only warn.
Patterns that trigger the destructive command guard. Case-insensitive substring match. Use pipe (|) for piped-command detection.
Patterns that bypass the destructive command guard. If a command matches both a blocked pattern AND an override, the override wins. E.g. 'rm -rf node_modules' to allow cleaning node_modules.

cloude-code-toolbox.safetyGuards.domainW.description: Enable domain whitelisting for web requests (WebFetch, WebSearch).

enumDescriptions: Only listed domains are allowed — everything else is blocked.
All domains are allowed except those explicitly blocked.
cloude-code-toolbox.safetyGuards.domainW.description: Whether to operate as an allowlist (strict) or blocklist (permissive).
Allowed domains (allowlist mode). Use *.domain.com for wildcard subdomains. Add your internal domains here.
Blocked domains (blocklist mode). These are denied even if other domains are allowed.

cloude-code-toolbox.safetyGuards.supplyC.description: Enable the supply chain guard. Blocks installation of known-compromised packages (event-stream, node-ipc, etc.).

enumDescriptions: Block the install command (exit code 2 — Claude cannot proceed).
Warn via stderr but allow the install to run.
cloude-code-toolbox.safetyGuards.supplyC.description: Whether to block compromised package installs or only warn.
Packages that must NEVER be installed. Known supply chain attacks, sabotaged packages, and protestware.

cloude-code-toolbox.oneClickSetup.initMe.description: Deprecated pre-0.5.15. Replaced by initMemoryBankMode. Removed automatically on activation if still present.

cloude-code-toolbox.intelligence.autoSca.description: When checked: after a workspace opens (debounced), save MCP & Skills awareness to `.claude/cloude-code-toolbox-mcp-skills-awareness.md` (overwritten), refresh hub, and update the MCP/skills block in `CLAUDE.md` — no editor tab. Re-runs on reopen so new MCP/skills are reflected. **Scan now** on the hub does the same immediately. In Claude Code, use `/mcp` for live tools; VS Code `mcp.json` is separate.

cloude-code-toolbox.agentTeams.enabled.description: Show the Agent Teams tab in the hub. Disable to hide the feature entirely.

cloude-code-toolbox.agentTeams.defaultMo.description: Model pre-filled in the New Agent form. Empty string means inherit from the calling session's default model.

cloude-code-toolbox.agentTeams.defaultPr.description: Default collaboration protocol when creating a new team. native/round-robin/handoff run inside a single `claude` session via the Task tool; plan-then-code / debate / orchestrator / parallel-fan-out use the Toolbox custom orchestrator.

cloude-code-toolbox.agentTeams.claudeBin.description: Absolute path to the `claude` CLI binary. Leave empty to auto-resolve via PATH. On Windows, a .cmd or .exe path is required for `shell:false` spawning.

cloude-code-toolbox.agentTeams.maxConcur.description: Cap for parallel-fan-out protocol (how many agents may run concurrently).

cloude-code-toolbox.agentTeams.costCapUs.description: Hard-stop a run when estimated spend exceeds this USD amount. 0 disables the cap.

cloude-code-toolbox.agentTeams.runArtifa.markdownDescription: Custom directory for team run artifacts (transcript, plan, decision). Leave empty for default: `{workspace}/.claude/runs/`. Supports `${workspaceFolder}` variable.

cloude-code-toolbox.agentTeams.preferNat.markdownDescription: When enabled, teams use Claude Code's native Agent Teams with `CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1` (requires CLI v2.1.32+). Enables teammate spawning, shared task lists, and mailbox messaging. When disabled, falls back to single-session native mode.

cloude-code-toolbox.agentDashboard.enabl.description: Opt-in: show live cards for every running Claude Code session. When enabled the toolbox writes hook entries to ~/.claude/settings.json and starts an HTTP listener on 127.0.0.1. Disable to remove both.

cloude-code-toolbox.agentDashboard.hookP.description: Port for the dashboard HTTP listener on 127.0.0.1. Set 0 for a random ephemeral port. The helper script is rewritten automatically if a fallback port is chosen.

cloude-code-toolbox.agentDashboard.inclu.description: Mirror our own orchestrator runs (Teams-tab protocols) into the dashboard alongside external sessions.

cloude-code-toolbox.agentDashboard.retai.description: Fade completed cards after this many milliseconds (0 = keep forever).

cloude-code-toolbox.agentDashboard.autoP.description: When an external Claude session's first prompt looks like planning (contains 'plan', 'design', 'architect', etc.), offer to pair it with the default team.

cloude-code-toolbox.agentDashboard.defau.description: Name of the team dispatched by auto-pair + planWithTeam when no explicit pick is made.

cloude-code-toolbox.agentDashboard.safet.description: Phase 1.6: install a PreToolUse safety guard helper that flags risky patterns (never blocks Claude; surfaces warnings in the dashboard).
Regex patterns (Python re syntax) that the safety guard looks for inside tool input values.
